inputs.name: Tiles sold, base year
Baseline growth in tiles sold (do nothing)
inputs.source: Case pack volume CAGR 2021-24 = 1.8%; Portugal tile consumption +3.6% 2025e, +2.4% 2026 (Confindustria Ceramica country report Portugal, Prometeia); 62% of sales exported to flatter EU markets -> base 1%
inputs.history_note: Not the 2021-24 volume CAGR (1.8%): the forward view uses the Portuguese tile-consumption outlook (+3.6% 2025e, +2.4% 2026) net of share loss; the history band is the cross-check

inputs.name: Ceiling: plant capacity
inputs.source: Case pack (Lusitania brief, fictional reported accounts): plant capacity 21 m m2/yr

inputs.name: Average net price, base year
Price inflation on tiles (baseline)
inputs.source: IMF Article IV Portugal (June 2026, via Lusa/ECO News): HICP 3.4% 2026, 2.3% 2027; ~2% thereafter (ECB target). Average 2025-29 ~2.4%

fetch.source: IMF Article IV / WEO (via ECO News)

request.database: Oxford Economics (or IMF WEO database direct)
request.table: Portugal > CPI / HICP inflation, annual % change

inputs.history_note: Average price grew 4.3%/yr 2021-24 (energy-cost pass-through in the 2022 spike); forward price growth = CPI only, so the do-nothing case does not assume another pass-through cycle

inputs.name: Unit conversion: m m2 x EUR/m2 = EURm
inputs.source: Arithmetic

inputs.name: Electricity bought, base year
inputs.source: Case pack (Lusitania brief, fictional reported accounts): electricity bought 2024

inputs.name: Natural gas used, base year
inputs.source: Case pack (Lusitania brief, fictional reported accounts): natural gas used 2024

inputs.name: Avoided grid electricity price (excl. VAT, band 70-150 GWh)
inputs.source: Eurostat nrg_pc_205, Portugal, non-household band ID 70-150 GWh, excl. VAT & recoverable taxes: average 2024S2-2026S1 = 0.0973 EUR/kWh (low 2026S1 0.0789, high 2024S2 0.114). NB case-pack energy cost 47.9m implies higher all-in prices than Eurostat (see Data Request: client invoices)

request.table: Lusitania energy invoices 2024: electricity EUR/MWh and gas EUR/MWh incl. network, CO2 (EU ETS) costs

inputs.name: Annual change in grid electricity price
inputs.source: Modelling choice: flat real-terms; Eurostat 2022-26 series volatile (0.06-0.15 EUR/kWh); range -3%/+2%

inputs.name: Avoided natural gas price (excl. VAT, band 1-4 m GJ)
inputs.source: Eurostat nrg_pc_203, Portugal, non-household band I5 (1-4m GJ), excl. VAT: average 2024S2-2026S1 = 11.76 EUR/GJ GCV = 42.3 EUR/MWh (low 2025S2 10.46 -> 37.7; high 2024S2 12.66 -> 45.6). Excludes EU ETS CO2 cost

inputs.name: Annual change in natural gas price
inputs.source: Modelling choice: flat; TTF forward curves in mild backwardation; range -5%/+3%

inputs.name: Solar PV installed (scale)
inputs.source: Brief: roof and adjacent land available for up to 12 MWp; scale = the brief's maximum (DEFAULT (team unavailable, card unconfirmed))

inputs.name: Solar yield, Aveiro (fixed, optimal tilt, 14% losses)
inputs.source: PVGIS v5.3 (EC JRC), lat 40.64 lon -8.65, 1 kWp crystalline-Si, 14% system loss: E_y = 1,275.5 kWh/kWp; interannual SD 33.7 kWh -> range +/- 2 SD

inputs.name: Share of solar output used on site
inputs.source: Derived: 12 MWp peak vs plant average load 95 GWh/8,760 h = 10.8 MW with continuous kilns; output < 20% of electricity bought, so near-full self-consumption; weekend/holiday surplus 0-10%

inputs.name: Solar: years to full output (build)
inputs.source: DEFAULT rollout plan: 1-year build (DEFAULT (team unavailable, card unconfirmed)); C&I PV of 10 MWp typically 6-12 months

inputs.name: Solar capex per MWp
inputs.source: IRENA Renewable Power Generation Costs in 2024 (via pv magazine 2025-07-23): Europe average total installed cost USD 779/kW = ~EUR 0.72m/MWp at 1.08 USD/EUR; rooftop C&I usually higher -> high 0.95

inputs.name: Solar O&M per MWp per year
inputs.source: IRENA RPGC O&M benchmarks for Europe, USD 10-20/kW/yr (not re-fetched in this run: verify)

inputs.name: Solar output degradation per year
inputs.source: Jordan & Kurtz (2013), Prog. Photovolt. 21(1): median degradation 0.5%/yr across ~2,000 field studies

inputs.name: Launch year: Solar
inputs.source: DEFAULT launch (DEFAULT (team unavailable, card unconfirmed))

inputs.name: Cut energy waste: % of gas use avoided at full rollout
inputs.source: Reference class of kiln/dryer heat recovery and combustion retrofits in tile plants (see bench_source); base = median
inputs.bench_source: reference class, 5 cases of gas saved in ceramic-tile plants: heat pipes on dryer 4-5% (EU DREAM/Brunel, Mirage), burner air preheat from cooling air 4.7% (Usak Univ. study), same with 200-250C air 8-10% (same study), Fincibec new combustion + hot-air recovery 15% (Ceramic World Web), roller-kiln cooling-gas recovery up to 17% (Univ. Jaume I, modelled). p25 4.7%, median 9%, p75 15%

request.table: TITLE-ABS-KEY(ceramic tile AND kiln AND (heat recovery OR energy saving))
request.filters: articles, 2010-2026, report % gas saved per plant

inputs.name: Cut energy waste: years to full rollout
inputs.source: DEFAULT: retrofit kilns and dryers over 3 years (DEFAULT (team unavailable, card unconfirmed); skill pattern for efficiency programmes)

inputs.name: Cut energy waste: capex per GWh/yr of gas avoided
inputs.source: Derived from reported paybacks: heat recovery 8-10 months (Usak/Bilecik studies) to 2-3 yrs for combustion retrofits, at 42 EUR/MWh -> 0.035-0.13 EURm per GWh/yr; base ~1.9-yr payback. PROVISIONAL

inputs.name: Launch year: Cut energy waste
inputs.source: DEFAULT launch (DEFAULT (team unavailable, card unconfirmed))

inputs.source: TCNA 2024 US Ceramic Tile Market Report: 2.70 bn sq ft in 2024 (FCNews 2025-04); TCNA 2025 report: market -4.9% in 2025 (Ceramic World Web / FCNews 2026-03) -> 2.57 bn sq ft x 0.0929 = 238.6 m m2

inputs.name: Premium design line: shift of volume into premium (8% -> 15%)
inputs.source: DEFAULT scale (DEFAULT (team unavailable, card unconfirmed)): premium share of volume from 8% (case pack) to 15% by full ramp

inputs.name: Premium design line: peak uplift in average price (mix)
inputs.source: Derived: price uplift = shift 7pp x (1.6 - 1) premium price ratio (case pack) = 4.2%. NB the plan input prem_shift is NOT linked by formula (spec limitation); ranges set consistently
inputs.bench_source: PROVISIONAL, fewer than 5 cases: premium/large-format share shifts of 4-10pp in 3-5 yrs implied by capacity additions (Kaleseramik slab capacity +50%, Atlas Concorde slab capacity doubled, Guocera 6->13.5m m2) x 0.6 price premium -> p25 2.4%, median 4.2%, p75 6.0%. Factiva request issued

inputs.name: Corporate tax rate (marginal, incl. derramas)
inputs.source: Portugal IRC 19% in 2026 (OE2026), falling to 17% by 2028 (econews 2025-07-18) + municipal derrama up to 1.5% + state derrama 3-5% band -> 23.5% (low 21.5% once IRC = 17%, high 25.5%)

inputs.source: Portugal 10y yield 3.65% (Trading Economics, 2026-08-21) - Damodaran default spread 1.02% = 2.63%

inputs.source: Damodaran betaEurope.xls (Jan 2026), Building Materials, 84 firms: levered beta 1.03, D/E 17.9%, unlevered (cash-corrected) 0.94

inputs.name: Mature-market equity risk premium
inputs.source: Damodaran ctryprem (Jan 2026): Aaa mature-market ERP 4.23% (US 4.46%)

inputs.name: Country risk premium, Portugal
inputs.source: Damodaran ctryprem (Jan 2026): Portugal A3, CRP 1.55%

inputs.name: Pre-tax cost of debt
inputs.source: Portugal 10y 3.65% + ~1.8% BBB-equivalent corporate spread for a 1.8x net debt/EBITDA mid-cap. PROVISIONAL

inputs.source: Damodaran Building Materials Europe D/E 17.9% -> D/V 15%; Lusitania own ~26% (net debt 45.9m vs EV ~7x EBITDA)

initiatives.name: Solar
initiatives.mechanism: Install up to 12 MWp PV on roof and land -> generate electricity on site -> buy fewer GWh from the grid

initiatives.name: Cut energy waste
initiatives.mechanism: Kiln/dryer heat recovery and burner upgrades -> less gas per m2 -> fewer GWh of gas bought

initiatives.name: Enter the US
initiatives.mechanism: Sell tiles to US distributors/dealers -> new buyers -> new revenue stream

initiatives.name: Sell online to installers
initiatives.mechanism: B2B web portal -> reaches installers that distributors do not serve -> new revenue stream

initiatives.name: Premium design line
initiatives.mechanism: Launch large-format/design collections -> mix shifts to tiles at 1.6x price -> higher average price

initiatives.name: Become the architects' choice
initiatives.mechanism: Specification team, BIM library and CPD for architects -> tiles specified in projects -> more m2 sold
